name: Ibusuki (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ibusuki city emblem in yellow, red and green: a yellow disc bearing a red butterfly above a green base with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ibusuki, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 August 2006.

features.role: Ibusuki city emblem — a yellow disc bearing a red butterfly above a green base with a stylised character
